title: Jailer 2 at Rs 816.9 Crore Closes In on Vijay's Tamil Nadu Record
excerpt: Twenty days into its run, the Rajinikanth starrer needs about Rs 6.8 crore more in Tamil Nadu to pass 'The Greatest of All Time' — the last major record it has not yet taken.
body:
• 'Jailer 2' has reached Rs 816.90 crore worldwide after 20 days, with India net collections of Rs 463.05 crore, according to Sacnilk figures reported by The Times of India.
  • In Tamil Nadu, the Rajinikanth starrer has grossed Rs 210.45 crore and needs about Rs 6.80 crore more to pass the state record held by Vijay's 'The Greatest of All Time'.
  • The Tamil version remains the film's engine, contributing Rs 1.93 crore of its Rs 3.35 crore India net on day 20.
  • The film, in Tamil, is already the highest-grossing Tamil film ever; US audiences can find it in theatres, with showtimes on theatre-chain sites, as its third week continues.

Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' has one major record left in its sights. After 20 days in theatres, the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial has collected Rs 816.90 crore worldwide, and in its home state of Tamil Nadu it is closing on the benchmark set by Vijay's 'The Greatest of All Time', according to Sacnilk figures reported by The Times of India.

"In Tamil Nadu, the Rajinikanth starrer has grossed Rs 210.45 crore and needs about Rs 6.80 crore more to pass the state record held by Vijay's 'The Greatest of All Time'."

The day-20 numbers

On Tuesday, its 20th day, the film earned Rs 3.35 crore in India net collections from 8,050 shows, taking its cumulative domestic net to Rs 463.05 crore and its India gross to Rs 541.65 crore. Overseas markets added Rs 1 crore on the day, for an international gross of Rs 275.25 crore — a worldwide total of Rs 816.90 crore. The Tamil version remained the biggest contributor, earning Rs 1.93 crore from 3,624 shows on day 20. Trade figures of this kind are industry estimates compiled from public sources and may be revised as studio data is updated.

The Tamil Nadu chase

The talking point of the third week is the state chart. 'Jailer 2' had grossed Rs 210.45 crore in Tamil Nadu after 18 days and, on the Times of India's figures, needs roughly Rs 6.80 crore more to overtake 'The Greatest of All Time' as the state's highest grosser. That would complete a clean sweep for the film: Pinkvilla's tracking had it passing the India record of Rajinikanth's own '2.0' earlier in the run — Rs 508.50 crore against Rs 508 crore — and it has already been established as the highest-grossing Tamil film worldwide, a run The Videshi tracked as it crossed Rs 800 crore.

What the film is

'Jailer 2', in Tamil, is the sequel to the 2023 hit 'Jailer' and brings back Rajinikanth as retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. It opened on October 15 and has sustained its run through the Diwali corridor with the kind of weekday holds that separate a festival spike from a phenomenon. Trade voices remain divided on the final ceiling: some distributors quoted in recent coverage hope it becomes the first Tamil film to reach Rs 1,000 crore worldwide, while others in the trade have argued the pace of the third week makes that mark unlikely. What is no longer in dispute is the ranking — every industry benchmark that matters for a Tamil film now has this one's name at the top, with the Tamil Nadu record the last one left to fall.

For diaspora audiences, the film continues in theatres in the US and other overseas markets — the Rs 275.25 crore overseas gross is itself a record for a Tamil film — with listings on the major theatre chains' sites.
